resources.string: To show power, add the “KPOWER Estim.” sensor as the power source in this Karoo ride profile.
KPower estimated instantaneous power. Add it to a page to show it live; logging to the FIT is separate (“Log estimated power”).
KPower estimated 3s power. Add it to a page to show it live; logging to the FIT is separate (“Log estimated power”).
KPower estimated normalized power. Add it to a page to show it live; logging to the FIT is separate (“Log estimated power”).
Recorded real ANT+ power meter (requires a recorded meter)
Recorded real meter 3s power (requires a recorded meter)
Recorded real meter normalized power (requires a recorded meter)

Tip: to feed this meter to the Karoo, pair the sensor named “KPOWER …” (your meter\'s name with a KPOWER prefix) in your ride profile — don\'t also pair the meter natively, or power will be recorded twice.

Records a detailed log file for each ride (every ANT+ page including unknown ones, parsed values, and connection events) so it can be analysed later. Off by default — it uses some extra battery and storage.
No bikes yet — tap + to add one.
KPower estimates your power. Add a bike, then pair the “KPOWER Estim.” sensor as the power source in your Karoo ride profile.
No valid config file found to import

Writes KPower\'s estimated power to the FIT as extra fields (est_power, est_np…) to compare against a real meter, AND field-calibrates your bike\'s Crr/CdA from the real meter (suggestion shown in the bike editor afterwards). Needs a real meter recording. Off by default.
Cycling dynamics from an enabled meter are written to the FIT automatically (the Karoo can\'t record them itself).
Record one ANT+ meter alongside the estimate (only one records at a time).
No meters recorded yet — pick one below.
Don\'t scan while recording a ride — it can disrupt the meter you\'re recording.
Keep the cranks still (don\'t pedal) during calibration. Don\'t calibrate while recording a ride.
Calibration failed. Make sure the meter is awake and the cranks are still.
Couldn\'t reach the meter (asleep or in use). Try again, or pair it in the Karoo first.
No response from the meter. Make sure it\'s awake and try again.
Shows a one-time in-ride alert when the recorded power meter\'s battery goes low, and again if it turns critical (at most two per ride). Battery status only updates while the meter is awake.
%1$s battery is low — charge or replace soon.
Link this profile to a Karoo ride profile so KPower auto-selects it when you ride that profile. “Default” = used for any ride profile you haven\'t linked.
A Karoo ride profile only appears here after you open it (or start a ride with it) once — KPower learns profiles as you use them.
If front and rear differ, enter the rear tyre — it carries most of the weight and dominates rolling resistance.
Default surface (used if the map can\'t be read)

KPower reads the OSM surface under you from the offline maps (/offline/maps) and adjusts the Crr live (paved/standard/gravel/sand). Needs offline maps for the area and storage permission; otherwise it keeps the surface you selected above.

Headwind detected: KPower will take temperature, pressure and wind from it and skip its own weather lookups. Wind assumes Headwind\'s default unit (km/h metric / mph imperial); if you set it to m/s or knots in Headwind, wind will be wrong.
Headwind not installed: KPower uses its own weather (Open-Meteo, automatic — no setup or API key).
Use Karoo temperature sensor as fallback?
This removes the bike configuration. This can\'t be undone.
